problem: Sanitized test fixture, not a newly approved feature: a local developer needs to open an existing Markdown document from either fixture source and see its contents.
users: Single local developer using MD Manager on localhost.
outcome: A selected eligible document is displayed; unavailable documents show a safe error without leaking machine paths.
decisions: D1: The user selects a document from source Pi or Claude; the complete source-relative path identifies it.
D2: Opening an eligible regular .md file (case-insensitive extension) displays the returned content without modifying disk; an empty file is a valid empty document.
D3: Each explicit open reads current content; no stale cached document may be shown as a successful new read.
D4: An unavailable document or failed read shows a visible error without absolute machine paths or stack traces. Do not invent exact wording.
D5: Scope is read-only viewing. Leave rendering style and error wording deferred. No graph redesign or write operation is required.
constraints: C1: Single-user localhost application; existing Pi and Claude fixture roots only.
C2: Respect the existing API's path validation and symlink exclusion. No new backend endpoint is requested.
scope: SC1: Open an existing selected eligible document and display returned content or a safe error.
exclusions: N1: Editing, autosave, create/rename/move/delete/copy, authentication, remote deployment and graph redesign.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Given an existing Pi or Claude .md document, selecting it displays its returned content and leaves its file bytes unchanged.
AC2: Given an uppercase .MD document or an empty .md document, opening succeeds and displays its content or a valid empty view.
AC3: Given a document changed externally, the next explicit open displays the current content, not the prior cached content.
AC4: Given a deleted, disallowed or unreadable target, opening shows an error and does not expose an absolute path or stack trace, or present a stale document as the requested document.
vertical_slices: S1 (proposed): Open/read/display a valid document from either source, including empty and uppercase-extension files; AC1 and AC2.
S2 (proposed, depends on S1): Fresh reopen and safe failure experience; AC3 and AC4.
assumptions: A1: Existing document selection supplies source and relative path; no new navigation behavior is decided.
open_questions: Q1 (deferred, nonblocking): Exact error wording and empty-view wording.
Q2 (deferred, nonblocking): Rendering style; this PRD requires content visibility only, not a new rendering engine.
rejected_alternatives: R1: Autosave/editing rejected for this fixture because it expands a read-only behavior into writes.
repository_facts: F1: README.md at MD Manager commit 146493b8322a7afab77b3eb46a845ea5175e59cd documents GET /api/file, Pi/Claude sources, case-insensitive .md eligibility, no-store responses, and safe 400/404/500 errors. This is observed implementation documentation, not additional user requirements.
F2: README.md identifies React/Vite/Fastify/TypeScript and explicit-save editing elsewhere; this does not expand the read-only test scope.
excerpts: Sanitized simulated grilling excerpt: 'Read-only opening only; keep writes and graph redesign out. Defer wording and rendering style.' This fixture tests the workflow, not a claim that a real user approved a new MD Manager feature.
